editorial.blurb: A lively American seafood spot in Chicago where the kitchen shines with beautifully executed dishes and craft cocktails, best experienced during their excellent happy hour.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit their happy hour for the Duplex burger, bone marrow toast, and honey Sriracha wings at better prices—service tends to be more attentive during these times, and arrive on weekdays if you want quicker seating.
